correctness.rationale: The six-antipodal-pair reduction is an exact algebraic identity for each graph-distance shell. A separate standard-library 4096-spin exact checker validates all equality profiles, counts, and rational boundary values; no numerical inference about infinite families is used.

value.rationale: This is the complete, naturally parametrized two-shell frustration phase diagram of the canonical icosahedral spin cluster, including two exact first-order exchange-correlation transitions, a middle 20-state antipodally aligned phase and critical 80-state coexistence. It reveals how an arbitrarily small second-shell exchange selects exactly 60 of the published 72 nearest-neighbor configurations, with structural six-antipode explanation. The specific invariant and finite graph are physically motivated by frustrated icosahedral magnetism, not an arbitrary slice.
